x: Goode, who is just turned 16 and bearing in mind that Derrick Burfitt won this race when about the same age, we hope that Goode will prove to be as good a runner as Derrick turned out to be.
Goode, our Youths champion, had been in bed during the week with 'flu and he should not really have run but did not want to let the team down.
Don Maclean won the junior mile, as expected, and from the way he went off he seemed quite determined to make sure that Geoff Goode had no reserves of speed left.

In the Youths' event our lads got away to a good start with Wright and Goode up in the first half-dozen. Then came tragedy in the fact that they were wrongly directed and by the time they got back on the right course they had lost quite a lot of ground and places.

The race was won by Roath of Walton(56:11)from Goode of Epsom with Baker of Horsham 3rd. Walker(59:28 9th),Moore(60.49,13th), and E.Bishop (62:12,16th) completed our scoring trio and they managed to snatch 3rd place from S.L.H. in what was a desperately close finish.
